description: The straight-line case: lru_eviction_bug's planted defect (byte-identical fixtures), its finding commanded. One file, one hunk, so ADR-0009's boundary says suggestion-shaped: fix steps are all `suggest`, no write chain. Shape is graded as the INVARIANT (kinds uniform, write chain iff patch), never a step inventory: how many suggest steps land on the file is the model's business, that a single-file fix isn't PR-shaped is the policy's.
shape_note: All-suggest is asserted, not exactly-one-step: the executor's delivery decision needs kind uniformity and span, nothing finer. new_contains_any accepts either correct fix (flip the flag, or restore the original idiom).
